prerequisites.title: Box developer account
prerequisites.detail: A free developer account gives access to the Developer Console, where OAuth 2.0 apps are created.

prerequisites.title: Own OAuth app credentials for production
prerequisites.detail: Composio's managed app is meant for prototypes; production should use your own client ID and secret.

prerequisites.title: A contact at each customer's Box admin team
prerequisites.detail: The admin needs your Client ID to authorize or enable the app in the Admin Console.

steps.title: Create a User (OAuth 2.0) app
steps.detail: Log into the Developer Console, select New App, choose User as the app type and create it.
steps.done_when: App exists with a Client ID and secret

steps.title: Copy Composio redirect URI
steps.detail: Take the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and check it uses HTTPS.

steps.title: Register redirect URI and scopes
steps.detail: Add the redirect URI in the OAuth 2.0 Redirect URI section of the Configuration tab and set scopes. It must match exactly.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config through Composio's API with your own client ID and secret.

steps.title: Send Client ID to customer admin
steps.detail: Copy the Client ID from the OAuth 2.0 Credentials section and give it to the customer's Box Admin or Co-Admin.

steps.title: Wait for admin authorization
steps.detail: The admin authorizes or enables the app in the Admin Console. Box cannot speed this up.
steps.done_when: App enabled for the customer enterprise

steps.title: Build and publish the integration
steps.detail: Publish the integration to the Box Integrations Center, then fill in the partner application form.

steps.title: Wait for Box review
steps.detail: Box reviews the App Center listing and the partner application separately; timing is not documented.
steps.done_when: Box accepts the listing or application

traps.title: Wrong app type cannot be changed
traps.detail: An OAuth 2.0 app cannot later be switched to Server Authentication, or the reverse. Create a new app instead.

traps.title: Scope changes need re-authorization
traps.detail: Enterprise developers must resubmit to the admin after saving changes. Free developer accounts re-authorize automatically.

traps.title: redirect_uri_missing error
traps.detail: With several redirect URIs configured, the authorization URL must include a redirect_uri that matches one exactly.

traps.title: Short token lifetimes
traps.detail: Access tokens last 60 minutes and refresh tokens 60 days or one use. Box does not allow long-lived tokens.

traps.title: API call allocation
traps.detail: Calls from custom apps count toward the customer's monthly allocation, and Box AI calls use separate AI Units.

blockers.symptom: Users cannot authorize the app; it appears disabled
blockers.what_it_means: The customer admin has turned on 'Disable unpublished apps by default', so the app needs explicit enablement.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask the admin to add your Client ID in the Admin Console under Platform Apps.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the request email with the Client ID and steps.

blockers.symptom: No reply on App Center review
blockers.what_it_means: Box staff only pointed one developer to the developer forum for status.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask in the Box developer forum and plan for long waits.
